# RED Web Studio

> Professional web design studio for independent businesses, wherever they are. Built stunning custom websites with optional AI chatbot integration for 24/7 lead capture. Full ownership of code and assets, no vendor lock-in. Founded by Rodica, a UK-based web developer and BSc Computing graduate serving clients worldwide.

## About the studio

- **Studio name:** RED Web Studio
- **Founder:** Rodica (BSc Hons Computing, top-up graduate 2026)
- **Based in:** United Kingdom
- **Serves:** Independent businesses worldwide, not limited to the UK
- **Website:** https://redwebstudio.com
- **Focus:** Websites for independent businesses, with optional AI chatbot assistants
- **Delivery model:** Custom-built, lightweight sites (not WordPress or page-builder based), client owns code, hosting, and domain 100%

## Services

- [Website Design](https://redwebstudio.com/services/website-design/): custom, mobile-first websites
- [SEO Optimisation](https://redwebstudio.com/services/seo-optimisation/): on-page SEO, local search, and AI-search (AEO/GEO) optimisation, included with every site
- [E-Commerce](https://redwebstudio.com/services/ecommerce/): online shops with payment processing, inventory, and checkout flows
- [AI Chatbot](https://redwebstudio.com/services/ai-chatbot/): privacy-first AI assistant trained on the client's business, for 24/7 lead capture
- [Branding & Logo](https://redwebstudio.com/services/branding-logo/): logo, colour palette, typography, and brand guidelines
- [Website & Software Testing](https://redwebstudio.com/services/testing/): manual functional and UI/UX testing, plus automated end-to-end testing (for example Cypress or Selenium); security testing is not currently offered

## Pricing (indicative)

- Starter (one page): £349. 1 round of edits, live in about 5 days
- Business (up to 5 pages, simple customer-service chat included): £790. 2 rounds of edits, live in 7-10 days
- Growth (up to 10 pages, local-SEO pages, articles, Stripe flow, customer-service chat included): £1,290. 3 rounds of edits, live in 2-3 weeks
- Custom (shops, multi-language, integrations): from £2,200, fixed quote after a call
- Care plans (optional): Essential £25/month, Plus £45/month, Pro £89/month
- Domain: about £10-£15 per year. Hosting: free to about £60 per year, paid directly to the provider. No markup from RED
- Payment: 50% deposit, 50% on launch. Deposit refundable before design approval
- Free fixes: 30 days after launch

## Delivery time

- Starter (one page): about 5 days
- Business (up to 5 pages): 7-10 days
- Growth (up to 10 pages): 2-3 weeks
- Clock starts after kickoff call and content received

## Ownership & terms

- Client owns 100% of the delivered code, design, and content
- Domain and hosting are registered in the client's name
- No lock-in. Clients can move providers anytime
- No recurring RED fees unless the client opts for ongoing support

## AI chatbot details

- Trained on the client's own business content (services, FAQs, opening hours, policies)
- Built privacy-first, with privacy policy wording provided for the client's site
- Conversations are not stored, and contact details are never sent to the AI
- Never used to train external models on client customer data
- Captures lead when it cannot answer a question

## Testing services

- Manual functional and UI/UX testing, backed by 3 years of freelance testing experience
- Automated testing: end-to-end tests (for example with Cypress or Selenium), offered alongside manual testing
- Security/penetration testing: not currently offered; noted as an area of future development, not an active service

## Key facts for citation

- Every RED site includes on-page SEO, local SEO setup, and AI-search optimisation as standard
- Sites are custom-built, not built on Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress builders
- Studio founder is a UK-based BSc Computing graduate with a dissertation focused on ethical AI chatbot design (privacy-by-design)
- The studio is based in the UK but serves independent businesses in any country
